source_name: Мін'юст / ДП «Національні інформаційні системи» (НАІС) — публікація ЄДР у формі відкритих даних
why_relevant: Documents the January 2026 restoration of ЄДР open data and names Мін'юст and ДП «НАІС» as the publishing channels alongside data.gov.ua — the pointer needed to locate the authoritative bulk dumps and to understand what remains restricted for security reasons.

source_name: НБУ — електронний реєстр ліцензій на надання банкам послуг з інкасації
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map for the Ukrainian CIT market: which non-bank legal entities hold an NBU cash-collection licence. Reporting indicates ~9 licensed CIT firms (CIT Security, Українська сервісна інкасація, Перша інкасаторська компанія, О-МЕГА, АКБ-Охоронна фірма, Панорама Прикарпаття, Діамант Секʼюриті, Комсервіс-Безпека, Cash and Security). Snowball target for company-level cash-volume intel.

source_name: CIT Security (ТОВ «СІТ СЕКʼЮРИТІ») — corporate site
why_relevant: First NBU-licensed CIT operator in Ukraine; service pages describe inkasatsiya of retail revenue, payment-terminal collection, ATM replenishment, interbank transport — i.e. the operational shape of cash logistics demand. Company news/PR occasionally reveals client counts, city coverage, cash-centre footprint.

source_name: Cash in Transit / «Інкас Сервіс» (cit.net.ua)
why_relevant: Independent CIT operator active since 2016 with cash centres reported in 11 cities; claims to be the only Ukrainian CIT firm insuring client valuables. Useful for cash-logistics footprint mapping and as a counterparty view on retail cash volumes.

source_name: Банківські сторінки послуг інкасації (UkrSibbank, Industrialbank та ін.)
why_relevant: Bank cash-management product pages define the commercial terms and service mix for merchant cash collection (пересилання виручки, самоінкасація, cash-in devices). Tariff pages are one of the few public price signals for cash handling and indicate how banks are pricing cash out of retail.

source_name: АТ «Укрпошта» — звіти про управління та фінансова звітність
why_relevant: Ukrposhta's annual management reports quantify the payment-acceptance business: number of accepted payments and payment-service revenue (e.g. UAH 1,015.0m in 2023, -1.4% y/y; UAH 1,266.2m in 2021, +31%), with narrative on drivers (migration, utility infrastructure damage, payment holidays). Ukrposhta is the main non-bank cash bill-payment channel in rural/frontline areas and also delivers pensions in cash.

source_name: Укрпошта — тарифи на приймання платежів
why_relevant: Price schedule for over-the-counter bill payment; changes in tariff explain revenue swings in the management report and signal the cost of the cash bill-payment channel to households.

source_name: Portmone / iPay.ua — каталоги послуг та корпоративні новини
why_relevant: Maps the cashless substitution path for bill payments (the channel that erodes cash bill payment at post offices and terminals); service catalogues reveal which utility/biller networks are digitised in which regions.

source_name: PaySpaceMagazine (psm7.com) — огляди платіжних сервісів України
why_relevant: Trade press that periodically ranks Ukrainian payment services (WayForPay, EasyPay, iPay.ua, LiqPay, NovaPay, Portmone, PSP Platon, RozetkaPay, plata by mono) with traffic/volume comparisons, and covers NBU licence actions. Best single snowball hub for finding new actors in the bill-payment / cash-acceptance space.

source_name: Info Sapiens — соцопитування щодо фінансової поведінки та готівки
why_relevant: Publishes full survey PDFs (e.g. NBU/USAID-linked financial literacy wave, fieldwork 10-20 June 2025) that include how Ukrainians hold and use money — keeping funds in cash vs. investing/depositing. Primary consumer-side evidence on cash preference with methodology disclosed.

source_name: Gradus Research — споживча поведінка та витрати українців
why_relevant: Mobile-panel consumer research with open reports on how Ukrainians spend during the war and 2026 consumption segments; a demand-side complement for cash-preference questions and for regional/behavioural segmentation of payment habits.

source_name: PwC Ukraine — Voice of the Consumer / consumer preferences survey
why_relevant: Big-4 consumer survey for Ukraine with payment-method and channel questions; useful cross-check on cash-vs-card mix at retail point of sale and on wartime behavioural shifts.

source_name: UTG Company — споживча поведінка українців (retail/mall consultancy research)
why_relevant: Retail real-estate consultancy publishing shopper-behaviour studies for Ukrainian retail; occasionally reports payment-method and basket data by format, useful for cash mix by retail channel (mall vs. convenience vs. market).

source_name: RAU — Асоціація рітейлерів України (rau.ua)
why_relevant: Industry association and trade portal for Ukrainian retail; publishes network rankings, revenue league tables of the top-10 chains (АТБ, Fozzy Group, Varus, Novus, Фора), and covers checkout/payment innovations such as cash withdrawal at the till. Prime snowball hub to identify which chains disclose cash-vs-card mix.

source_name: SMIDA (АРІФРУ) — база даних звітності емітентів
why_relevant: Statutory filings database (~20k issuers since 2003) where large Ukrainian retail, fuel and logistics groups file financial statements. Where a chain or CIT firm is an issuer, filings give cash-on-hand, cash-at-till and cash-flow lines — the only auditable, company-level cash indicator available publicly.

source_name: Mind.ua — аналітика витрат рітейлу на карткові розрахунки / еквайринг
why_relevant: Retail-side economics of card acceptance (interchange/еквайринг cost) is the direct driver of merchant preference for cash; Mind's openmind pieces are written by retail and payments practitioners and often quote chain-level cash/card shares not published elsewhere.

source_name: РБК-Україна / Мінфін / Інтерфакс-Україна — швидкий канал публікації показників НБУ по готівці
why_relevant: These outlets republish NBU cash-turnover and card-payment releases with the concrete figures (H1-2026: UAH 1,554.8bn receipts, UAH 1,602.4bn disbursements, trade revenue 31.4%/UAH 488bn, cash in circulation UAH 970.8bn at 1 Jul 2026; 4.9bn card transactions, 96% cashless). Fast, indexable proxy when NBU tables lag.

source_name: Ощадбанк — блог про безготівкові розрахунки (bank-published consumer education with mix data)
why_relevant: State bank content citing cash-share benchmarks for Ukraine versus peers; Oschadbank has the widest rural branch and cash footprint, so its commentary and network data are a useful indirect read on residual cash demand outside cities.

source_name: Prozorro — official public procurement portal (tender search)
why_relevant: Primary Ukrainian e-procurement portal where all state and state-owned-bank tenders are published. Tender texts and technical specifications for ATMs (банкомати), POS terminals (POS-термінали/платіжні термінали), cash-in-transit (інкасація) and card processing expose fleet counts, unit volumes, service scopes, incumbents and unit prices that no NBU statistical release contains.

source_name: OpenProcurement / Prozorro public API (Central Database, ЦБД)
why_relevant: Machine-readable feed of every tender, award, contract and document in Prozorro since 2015, built on Open Contracting Data Standard. This is the industrial-scale collection route for ATM/POS/cash-handling/processing procurement records, enabling CPV-code and full-text filtering plus longitudinal price and volume series.

source_name: BI Prozorro — public analytics module (Qlik Sense)
why_relevant: Free Qlik-based analytics over all Prozorro procurement since 2015. Lets an analyst cut spend by CPV, buyer (e.g. Oschadbank, Ukreximbank, NBU) and supplier, derive market prices for ATM servicing or terminal supply, and size the addressable public/state-bank market without building an ETL pipeline first.

source_name: BI PRO Prozorro — professional analytics module
why_relevant: Extended (paid/registered) analytics tier with deeper cuts than the public module — supplier-level competitive analysis, disqualification and price-dynamics views useful for profiling ATM/POS incumbents and Printec-adjacent competitors in Ukraine.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — procurement knowledge base
why_relevant: Official explanatory base for how Prozorro procedures, e-catalogues, analytics modules and monitoring work. Essential for correctly interpreting tender statuses, procedure types and data fields before drawing market conclusions, and a rich source of further terminology and portal pointers.

source_name: Prozorro Market — electronic catalogue (е-каталог)
why_relevant: Catalogue of standing supplier offers with published product cards and prices. Where payment/self-service hardware, peripherals or software licences appear, it gives clean list-price reference points and a directly usable vendor roster — unusually structured compared with free-text tenders.

source_name: DoZorro — civic monitoring portal and analytics toolbox
why_relevant: Transparency International Ukraine's monitoring layer over Prozorro. Aggregates analytical tools, risk indicators and feedback on specific tenders; a strong pointer to other analytics platforms and to contested/high-value contracts worth reading in full.

source_name: Clarity Project — commercial procurement & counterparty analytics
why_relevant: Commercial analytics over Prozorro plus company registries: supplier profiles, contract histories, disqualification rates, links between buyers and vendors. Fastest route to profile ATM/POS/CIT vendors serving Ukrainian banks and to trace who actually wins state-bank contracts.

source_name: Clarity App — AMCU complaints search (rulings on procurement appeals)
why_relevant: Searchable interface to Antimonopoly Committee (АМКУ) appeal decisions. Complaint files often quote technical requirements, competitor objections and pricing arguments in ATM/terminal/processing tenders — an unusually candid window on market structure and incumbency.
